'''Old Deer''' is a [[wolf]].

==Activities==
Old Deer, along with [[Two Moons]], [[Wildfire]], [[Half Tail]], [[Rabbit Nose]], [[Morning Clouds]] and many more are known to [[Perrin Aybara]]. They scout for Perrin when [[Rand al'Thor]] was captured by Aes Sedai.{{ref/book|6|54}}
